data.one_liner: A 2D single-stroke gesture and shape recognizer for Dart and Flutter.
data.what_it_does: Recognizes 2D single-stroke gestures and shapes using the $1 Unistroke Recognizer algorithm and Protractor enhancement. It can match default shapes like lines, circles, rectangles, triangles, and stars, or custom unistrokes. It also provides methods to convert user strokes into canonical shapes.
use_when: You need to recognize handwritten shapes or gestures in a Flutter application.
You are building a drawing, note-taking, or whiteboard app and want to clean up user shapes.
avoid_when: You need multi-stroke handwriting or complex gesture recognition.
You require heavy machine learning classification beyond geometric template matching.
strengths: Lightweight and requires very few templates to perform well.
Includes helpful helpers to convert user input into canonical geometric shapes.
Supports both default and custom unistrokes with type safety.
weaknesses: Relies entirely on geometric matching, which may struggle with erratic or inconsistent strokes.
